images.alt: Jesus Christ kneels in prayer beside a rock in a moonlit olive grove
Stars fill the sky above still water. Let the quiet of this imagined landscape lead you to the scriptures about Jesus Christ, the Creator.
A path leads from green shelter into open, rugged country. Read Lehi’s teaching about agency and redemption.
The sheep rests in His arms. Jesus tells of a shepherd who goes after the one that is lost.
Two figures face the morning beside cultivated ground and a simple altar. This imagined scene of Adam and Eve invites us to read the promise of redemption they received.
Bread, herbs, a cup, and a lamp invite a pause to remember Passover. This symbolic still life leads to the account of deliverance and to Jesus Christ, the Lamb of God.
Bread and a cup rest on a quiet table. Return to the Savior’s words at the Last Supper.
Under the olive trees, Jesus bows in prayer. Read His words to the Father.
From above and behind the cross, we look toward the people gathered below and Jerusalem beyond. John records the Savior’s love and His finished work.
From beside and behind the cross, we see those who have stayed nearby. John records the Savior’s tender care for His mother and the beloved disciple.
Morning light enters a rock-cut tomb. Read the witnesses’ accounts of the risen Savior.
A woman turns toward the risen Jesus in a garden. John records that He called Mary by name.
Jesus walks beside two listeners on a country road. Read how He opened the scriptures to the disciples traveling to Emmaus.
Jesus leans toward an older woman as others wait nearby. Read of His compassion and healing among the people in the Book of Mormon.
An open book and notebook sit before a thoughtful reader. Choose a passage and linger with it.
A man bows his head in the quiet of his home. There is room to speak honestly with God.
An elderly father holds his returning son. Read the parable Jesus told about repentance and welcome.
Two neighbors exchange a tool at a workshop door. Consider the practical work of making amends.
A woman sits with open scriptures and a quiet expression of gratitude. Consider the change Christ can bring to a heart.
Jesus speaks while those around Him listen. Bring a question to His teachings.
Neighbors carry bags together. Bearing another person’s burden often begins with ordinary help.
Jesus attends to an older man. The Gospels describe His compassion for those who needed Him.
A woman rests her hand on another woman’s arm as she weeps. Presence can be a quiet gift in grief.
Jesus kneels with a basin and towel. He asks His disciples to follow His example of service.
Water cups wait on the sacrament table. Read the prayer that asks us to remember Jesus Christ.
Jesus welcomes a child and an accompanying adult. Read His invitation to let children come to Him.
